newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria to tender for satellite data system.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria to tender for satellite data system.

text.p: Bulgaria's outgoing cabinet decided on Thursday to hold a tender for building and operating a national VSAT (Very Small Aperture Terminal) satellite data system, a government official said.
The chief of the government's concession department Nikola Baltov said the system would ensure the fast and precise transmission of data.
The concession will be awarded for 21 years and be granted through a competition, Baltov said.

Posts and Communications Committee chairman Lyubomir Kolarov said earlier this year that concessions would be also given for a second GSM operator, an NMT 450 network, national paging networks, a television network and UKV radio network.
Liberalisation of the telecommunications sector involves the sale of a 25 percent stake in the Bulgarian Telecommunication Company (BTC).
Last December, the government shortlisted six banks to advise it on the partial sale of the BTC.
